other_eligibility: Must be admitted to Western Michigan University as an initial F-1 or J-1 undergraduate (freshman or transfer)
No separate application; complete WMU admission and the scholarship is awarded on a rolling basis while funds last
Up to eight semesters or until graduation
Applies to tuition only; not for fully online programs
Cannot be combined with full government/NGO tuition scholarships or full WMU assistantships
Meeting eligibility does not guarantee an award
